title: Concept: Registry password stored in the client configuration
description: .npmrc declares a registry password written directly into the checked-in client configuration, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The credential is readable by everyone who can read the repository or a build log that echoes the file, and it cannot be scoped or expired like a token.
risk: The credential is readable by everyone who can read the repository or a build log that echoes the file, and it cannot be scoped or expired like a token.
